prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Make an animation sprite atlas for this EXACT existing JRPG pixel art character. Input 1 is the approved character identity/style. Input 2 is her approved movement and yawn reference. Preserve her face, adult/slender anime proportions, original pixel cluster style and low-detail pixel rendering, black long hair with pink clip, black wrap jacket with cobalt blue trim, pink sash, black skirt with blue hem, black lace-up boots, and metal chain in her lowered hand. Do NOT redesign, make chibi, smooth illustrated art, add effects or increase detailing. Face 3/4 toward screen right like the standing poses. This character is lazy, sleepy, bored, coolheaded and occasionally quietly clumsy.
Output transparent square 1536x1536 sprite sheet, STRICT 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 equal 384x384 cells, read left to right top to bottom. One whole body per cell, exactly same scale, head/hip center alignment and supporting foot position. Body approximately 270 pixels tall, center horizontally in each cell, boots on cell y=350. Plenty of transparent margin. Chain is slack, subtly blue steel, no glow. No labels, panels, shadows or text.
These are restrained battle-idle animation poses, not constant dancing, toe tapping or big gestures. Feet planted in same modest fighting stance. Cool expression facing the enemy, lowered relaxed shoulders. Only a tiny weight transfer. Clear meaningful changes, not random changes in anatomy/position.
Frames 0-3: a very gentle breathing/weight-settle loop: 0 calm half-lidded neutral standing, 1 breath rises slightly shoulders by 1-2 pixels, 2 slightly shifts hip toward supporting leg without moving feet, 3 relaxes into that pose. Head nearly stationary, chain and hair follow minimally.
Frames 4-7: a slow sleepy blink from the neutral pose: 4 eyelids droop, 5 eyes closed slight chin dip, 6 eyes half reopen, 7 neutral awake/cool again. Hands and boots unchanged from neutral.
Frames 8-11: a SMALL tired yawn in same planted stance: 8 free hand begins raising towards mouth, 9 hand near lips eyelids drop, 10 covers small yawn mouth eyes closed, 11 hand lowering and eyes opening. Keep chain in lowered other hand at all times. No head thrown back.
Frames 12-15: rare understated clumsy beat: 12 notices slack chain has caught at front boot, glances down; 13 front toe barely lifts and chain hand gently raises slack to free it; 14 chain cleared, toe lowers, a tiny sheepish sideways eye glance, no theatrical face; 15 composed neutral again with chain lowered. Support foot stays exactly fixed. This is a small self-correction, never a stumble or jump.
All poses must blend as one sprite animation, with consistent silhouette, costume, chain-hand side, proportion and grounding. Transparent background with true alpha.
continuity_correction: Edit the latest 4x4 Yeonwoo pixel animation sheet. Preserve exact pixels/style/identity/proportions/composition wherever possible. Fix ONLY chain/hand continuity and grid registration: in ALL 16 cells the chain MUST stay in her hand on SCREEN RIGHT (her left hand), hanging to the RIGHT of her boots. In third row yawn frames, use the free SCREEN LEFT hand to cover the mouth while SCREEN RIGHT hand holds chain. In fourth row she glances at the chain by SCREEN RIGHT boot; gently lift that boot tip and SCREEN RIGHT chain hand, clear slack, then return to neutral. Never switch chain hands. Neutral pose must match first row across transitions. Ensure exact 4x4 equal-cell sprite atlas with unchanged scale and planted supporting boot SCREEN LEFT identical x,y relative to every cell. Remove tiny stray marks at cell edges; no grid lines. Truly transparent background. Preserve old pixel art style, pink accents, face and restrained poses. No redesign.
